goal: Serve witnessless blocks to peers without full deserialization and reserialization overhead
Avoid unnecessary memory allocations and redundant hashing when serving legacy block requests
agreement: Strong support with extensive verification and no open objections (fametrano)
Verified byte-for-byte equivalence on 214 blocks and confirmed 7.2x to 9.0x speedups (fametrano)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because witnessless blocks are primarily requested by legacy peers today
Cuts block preparation time by roughly 9x while reducing heap allocations
Unblocks efficient block serving needed for proposed witnessless assumevalid IBD
